items.title: LyondellBasell (LYB) Stock May Still Look Cheap Despite Refinery Sale
items.summary: LyondellBasell Industries has delivered a 1 year return that many holders will notice, yet the sharper question now is whether the current share price still lines up with the earnings that underpin it. After a mix of solid recent results and portfolio reshaping, the focus turns to what those profits really justify. Over the past 12 months, LyondellBasell Industries has gained 47.0%, which puts more pressure on today’s valuation to be supported by its profit power rather than past share price...

items.title: 2 Chemical Giants Cut Their Dividends. This Third Stock Kept Raising
items.summary: Overcapacity, Middle East turmoil, and shaky margins have forced some chemical makers to shrink the checks they send shareholders. Retirees chasing yield in this sector face one question: whose payout is built on cash flow, and whose still carries risk?

items.title: Western Union Yields 15.3%. Here Are 4 More Dividend Stocks Flashing Warning Signs
items.summary: A 15% yield can feel like a windfall right up until the board votes to end it. These five dividend stocks are flashing the same warning signs that have preceded painful cuts before.

items.title: How Will Air Products and Chemicals Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: Air Products and Chemicals (NYSE: APD) will discuss its fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter results on a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $70.4 billion. Over the last twelve months, it generated $12.6 billion in revenue and $3.1 billion in operating profit before charges for business and asset actions. After those charges, it posted a net loss of $47 million.

items.title: Valero to Acquire Houston Refining Site, Plans 165,000 BPD Restart
items.summary: VLO's $320.5M Houston refining site acquisition is expected to expand its refining operations, with plans to restart 165,000 BPD of light crude capacity by 2027.

items.title: LyondellBasell to Sell Former Houston Refinery Site for $320.5M
items.summary: LYB's $320.5M Houston refinery site sale to Valero advances its portfolio transformation, streamlines operations and supports long-term value creation.

items.title: LyondellBasell (LYB) Stock Rallies On Q3 Earnings And Cash Strength
items.summary: LyondellBasell came into this Q3 2026 report with a stock that had already been rebuilding confidence over the past month; then the latest numbers lit a fresh spark. The share price jumped 5% to US$68.64 on the first full trading day after earnings, as investors reacted to a quarter anchored by US$2.38 in basic earnings per share and US$8.5b in revenue. For a chemicals producer often viewed through the lens of heavy cyclicality and balance sheet worries, the story today is about profit...
